answer: Reef-plot tide-handover bond: each identity locks 70, takes a reef plot for one tide, and files a key-signed tide log in the fable ledger. The next steward checks the log against the reef first; a missing, copied or late log burns it. The k-th steward pays 32+5(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 2,529,500+70,000. Honest agents pay 32 once, bond back after a clean tide. Failure mode: rented-log ring, caught when one key signs two plots in the fable ledger.
